exposure: weight/length ratio for gestational age at birth
outcome: chronology of eruption of primary mandibular central incisors
cohort: A cohort of 46 preterm infants with low/very low/extreme low birth weight, who were at least four months of age, were followed at a university hospital in Belo Horizonte, Brazil.
finding: Small-for-gestational age infants experienced delayed eruption of primary mandibular central incisors compared to large-for-gestational age infants, with the average eruption age for the cohort being 11 months.
